messages:
incident-bot: SEV-2 declared — Batch inference (/v1/batch) experiencing throughput degradation and elevated queueing. Investigating. Incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1712523456

oliver (oncall): Noted. Observing large queue depth on gpu-pool-2, latency spike for batch jobs >10k tokens. Error rate trending up.

raj (serving-runtime): Root cause signal: interaction between continuous-batcher and recent scheduler config (max_batch_time reduced). Long-running batches aren't being preempted; KV-cache growth prevents slot recycling.

maria (eng-sre): Mitigation plan: 1) provision +2 nodes to gpu-pool-2 2) enable force-preempt for batches >30s 3) add traffic routing for large-batch traffic to fallback cluster. Implementing now. :thumbsup:

oliver (oncall): Scaling started — +2 nodes requested (ETA ~3m). Applying force-preempt flag to scheduler.

infra-bot: Provisioning started for 2 nodes in gpu-pool-2 (approx 180s). Autoscaler event id: asg-7891.

support-bot: CS update sent to top 5 impacted customers. Recommended workaround: chunk large payloads into smaller batches (<=5k tokens) and add exponential backoff on retries. Tickets created for urgent customers.

raj (serving-runtime): After preempt toggle: queue depth down ~60%. Error rate reduced to ~3.2% (was 8.1%). Tail latency still elevated (~150ms uplift). Will continue metrics sweep.

maria (eng-sre): Current status: Mitigated -> partial. Provisioned capacity increment completed, routing policy applied for heavy tenants. Impact: some very large batches still see >20s processing; otherwise throughput normalizing. Monitoring for 30m before removing temp settings.

oliver (oncall): If you hit repeat failures, paste request-id + sample headers here. Keeping on-call pager active. Postmortem owner: raj.

lena (product-support): Logged cs-ticket-9812 for Zephyr Labs and attached mitigation steps. Will follow up with timeline and ETA once monitoring window completes.

incident-bot: Update 09:45 UTC — Incident state: Mitigated (reducing customer impact). Monitoring for recurrence. Full postmortem draft due in 72h. Incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1712523456

raj (serving-runtime): Commands used for mitigation:

```
kubectl scale deployment/gpu-pool-2 --replicas=4
# applied scheduler flag
kubectl set env deployment/continuous-batcher FORCE_PREEMPT=true
```

maria (eng-sre): Thanks everyone. We'll post the postmortem and follow-ups in this thread when ready.
